decisions.coupling: Added nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue and the boundary halo; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with score 0.884.

decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff, retaining the near-floor maximum-safe fallback limitation.
